title: Zero-Trust Network Architecture
scenario: A government agency requires a zero-trust network architecture where no implicit trust is granted based on network location. All traffic must be inspected, all access must be authenticated, and all communication must be encrypted. Design a VPC architecture that implements zero-trust networking principles.
requirements: AWS Network Firewall for all east-west and north-south traffic inspection
PrivateLink for all AWS service access (no internet paths)
Micro-segmentation using security groups (one per workload)
No public subnets — all ingress through Network Firewall
VPC Flow Logs enabled on all subnets for audit
Separate VPCs for each trust boundary with Transit Gateway routing
